chapter: Youth, Storyville and the bands he heard
title: Early drumming and Freddie Gould
summary: Drummed with Henry Ford; knew guitarist Freddie Gould from the Ninth Ward but never played with him.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Who did you drum with? I like to get the early stuff, you know, like that. Like those early, early guys. When you were playing drums?
Well, let's see. Well, I just mentioned one to you. Henry Ford. Henry Ford. Yeah. Let's see. Who else? I got a couple of them, but I can't remember right now.
Did you ever know Freddie that played guitar from the Ninth War? Played with his fingers sometimes, I said, no pity. Freddie? Freddie Gould.
Freddie Gould, yeah. Yeah, I know him.
Yeah, did you ever play with him?
No. No, I know him though.
I never have been able to find him.
No. He was raised in the Ninth War. But some of these people, you know, leave the neighborhood and never come back no more.
